newsitem.title: USA: ACNielsen aims to double net, oper income.
newsitem.headline: ACNielsen aims to double net, oper income.

text.p: ACNielsen Corp said it expects "steadily higher income" in each of the remaining quarters of 1997, while it aims to double operating margins, operating income and net income for the full year.

ACNielsen narrowed its first quarter loss to $4.1 million or $0.07 per share, compared to last year's net loss of $19.2 million or $0.34 a share. Led by a profit improvement in the United States, the company said it reduced its first quarter operating loss by $9.6 million to $9.2 million.
"Our first quarter results demonstrate our continuing progress in turning ACNielsen toward profitable growth," said Nicholas Trivisonno, ACNielsen's chairman and chief executive officer.
ACNielsen said it remains focused on its primary objectives to grow the business profitably, providing superior service to clients, and creating superior long-term value for shareholders.
ACNielsen, which provides market research and analysis to consumer products and services industries, was spun off from Dun & Bradstreet Corp on November 1.
